response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City AS City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM rep_counts), city_avg AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City) SELECT r.City, SUM(r.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(r.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess, AVG(r.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt) AS avg_share FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_avg a ON a.City = r.City CROSS JOIN total t WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt GROUP BY r.City
